7ee5fc1b-8108-5fb4-a254-f75af84695f3.definition: A letter for a job application.
7ee5fc1b-8108-5fb4-a254-f75af84695f3.scene: Photo: Top-down documentary close-up on a charcoal desk: dark-skinned hands slide a cream letter and separate work-history page into a kraft envelope; yellow pencil, warm side light, no faces or decorative room.
7ee5fc1b-8108-5fb4-a254-f75af84695f3.alt: Hands put a cover letter and resume into an envelope.

8a7f86d3-ed7a-512c-9c19-d86b5d46ffa8.definition: A list of topics planned for a meeting.
8a7f86d3-ed7a-512c-9c19-d86b5d46ffa8.scene: Diagram: White background, large coral and teal meeting-topic cards arranged in an ordered vertical sequence beside a small round meeting-table icon; one hand places the next card; no full office or realistic faces.
8a7f86d3-ed7a-512c-9c19-d86b5d46ffa8.alt: A hand arranges meeting-topic cards in order beside a meeting table.

d62f1f3f-8382-5999-9e9c-30858f6b2c5b.scene: Photo: Wide candid airport inspection: older East Asian man in a rust raincoat opens a hard black suitcase while a Black female customs officer in a dark uniform checks folded clothing; cool fluorescent architecture.
d62f1f3f-8382-5999-9e9c-30858f6b2c5b.alt: A customs officer checks clothes inside a traveller's open suitcase.

4c3724d8-5abf-5159-8171-76ccdcdae7c0.definition: A message sent after an interview.
4c3724d8-5abf-5159-8171-76ccdcdae7c0.scene: Diagram: Two-frame peach-and-charcoal visual timeline: left an applicant in a green jacket at an interview table, right the same person sending a later envelope-message icon; one clear arrow connects interview to later message.
4c3724d8-5abf-5159-8171-76ccdcdae7c0.alt: An applicant sends a message after a job interview.

446b7b9e-8190-5987-9401-0378e95ff493.scene: Diagram: Mint-and-navy process strip: an earlier team meeting circle, a later message with a progress-check icon, then a small project task; make the later checking action clear, no realistic room.
446b7b9e-8190-5987-9401-0378e95ff493.alt: A meeting is followed by a message and a later check on the work.

ce20a0cc-6a7e-5b5e-bbfe-5ec49f1c58d5.scene: Photo: Candid university office in late afternoon, a silver-haired woman instructor in a red cardigan leans over a student's notebook; student with short curly hair in a mustard shirt gestures to a question; bookshelves and dark wood.
ce20a0cc-6a7e-5b5e-bbfe-5ec49f1c58d5.alt: A lecturer helps a student with an open notebook during office hours.

3008733d-9cab-547c-9712-4014a26ca697.definition: The hotel counter for guest help.
3008733d-9cab-547c-9712-4014a26ca697.scene: Photo: Modern tropical hotel reception, tall bearded receptionist in a cream uniform extends a key sleeve to a guest in an orange coat with teal rolling luggage; palm shadows and polished stone; diagonal handover action.
3008733d-9cab-547c-9712-4014a26ca697.alt: A hotel receptionist gives a guest a key card at the front desk.

6a61d337-80e7-5d50-bc61-8b45b6a054a1.definition: The place where you board your plane.
6a61d337-80e7-5d50-bc61-8b45b6a054a1.scene: Photo: Wide airport architecture at blue hour: glass boarding doorway, passengers walking with carry-ons toward a visible aircraft; varied coats, silhouettes small, cyan sky and amber departure lighting.
6a61d337-80e7-5d50-bc61-8b45b6a054a1.alt: Travellers walk through an airport gate toward an aircraft.

1e91dacc-7700-5f65-9310-312ac4dff706.definition: A person interested in a project.
1e91dacc-7700-5f65-9310-312ac4dff706.scene: Diagram: Isometric community-building model at center; distinct resident, shopkeeper and project manager pictograms connect to relevant parts with three simple colored lines; forest green, brick red and sand, no copied character faces.
1e91dacc-7700-5f65-9310-312ac4dff706.alt: A resident, shop owner and site manager are connected to the same construction project.

8a6ec801-3292-5fc2-bfb3-242ac405d891.definition: A document that lets you get on your flight.
8a6ec801-3292-5fc2-bfb3-242ac405d891.scene: Photo: Macro of a tan hand scanning a generic boarding pass barcode at a gate reader; white paper, black reader, red suitcase edge, defocused aircraft beyond; decisive passing motion, no legible private information.
8a6ec801-3292-5fc2-bfb3-242ac405d891.alt: A traveller scans a boarding pass beside an aircraft at the gate.

5b7f44dd-77ba-5d20-9ee4-01d6967d203a.scene: Illustration: Lively science workshop: one blond student in orange cuts cardboard, one dark-skinned student in green assembles a bridge, another East Asian student in a white shirt draws a plan; bold ochre, forest green and sky palette, overhead diagonal view.
5b7f44dd-77ba-5d20-9ee4-01d6967d203a.alt: Three students draw, cut materials and build a model bridge together.

8f12f8e0-d0a3-5010-941b-8f7d526121cc.scene: Diagram: Minimal travel-route diagram with three airport nodes: plane arriving at the middle node, small waiting traveller and bag at center, next plane departing toward final node; indigo, orange and white, clear stop between flights.
8f12f8e0-d0a3-5010-941b-8f7d526121cc.alt: A flight journey includes a traveller waiting at an airport between two flights.

329c4ec9-6562-568e-9e71-9134da2f0d8d.definition: A list of food and drinks you can order.
329c4ec9-6562-568e-9e71-9134da2f0d8d.scene: Photo: Close candid over-shoulder restaurant view: older bald diner with round glasses studies a menu featuring food photographs while a server waits; deep burgundy tablecloth, copper lighting, no illustration texture or readable menu words.
329c4ec9-6562-568e-9e71-9134da2f0d8d.alt: A diner looks at a menu with food pictures while a server waits.

c954cdb6-c0bc-5d61-9045-18db360f4b84.definition: A goodbye, especially when someone is leaving for a long time.
c954cdb6-c0bc-5d61-9045-18db360f4b84.scene: Illustration: Dynamic seaside ferry departure: a woman with cropped red hair in a yellow windbreaker waves from the gangway while two friends on the pier wave back; wind lifts scarves, turquoise sea and white sky, wide composition.
c954cdb6-c0bc-5d61-9045-18db360f4b84.alt: A traveller on a ferry waves goodbye to friends on the quay.

5d21c02b-ef51-5545-bd8a-01f5814d3a67.definition: The statement showing how much you need to pay.
5d21c02b-ef51-5545-bd8a-01f5814d3a67.scene: Photo: Object-focused close-up of a restaurant bill folder beside empty ceramic plates and a green glass bottle; a hand lifts the payment slip; dark walnut table, directional evening light, no faces or readable text.
5d21c02b-ef51-5545-bd8a-01f5814d3a67.alt: A hand lifts the bill from a folder beside finished restaurant dishes.

bee2408e-5991-5805-923c-6fba33ab7e7a.definition: Bags and suitcases you take on a trip.
bee2408e-5991-5805-923c-6fba33ab7e7a.scene: Photo: Three contrasting travel bags in a lively station foreground: vivid red suitcase, worn olive duffel, small black roller; a cropped hand pulls one handle, no people posed together; textured concrete and bright daylight.
bee2408e-5991-5805-923c-6fba33ab7e7a.alt: A traveller wheels a red suitcase past a black suitcase and a duffel bag.

71c851c2-c028-5d8f-9e0a-5be524410a82.scene: Diagram: Three task cards leave a completed meeting-circle icon toward three different worker silhouettes; each card uses a distinct tool/project pictogram; cobalt, coral and sunflower, simple spatial assignment arrows.
71c851c2-c028-5d8f-9e0a-5be524410a82.alt: Arrows assign three task cards from a meeting to three people.

0b9878b3-64a7-5175-92f7-ce0435cfbed4.definition: The pay range you hope to receive.
0b9878b3-64a7-5175-92f7-ce0435cfbed4.scene: Diagram: Clear proposed pay-range concept: interview handshake icon above a horizontal range with smaller and larger coin stacks at its ends; olive and gold on pale cream; no numbers or money labels.
0b9878b3-64a7-5175-92f7-ce0435cfbed4.alt: Two people shake hands above a pay range between smaller and larger coin stacks.

1eee9c5f-7079-54d4-bcd8-183739df837a.definition: To share ideas freely to solve a problem.
1eee9c5f-7079-54d4-bcd8-183739df837a.scene: Illustration: Outdoor community workshop around a large paper sheet: people sketch different ideas rapidly with markers; middle-aged man in a coral shirt, woman with braids in denim, older woman in white; cyan canopy, earthy terracotta and energetic hands.
1eee9c5f-7079-54d4-bcd8-183739df837a.alt: People share and sketch ideas together on a large sheet at an outdoor workshop.

ac93d068-7c3e-55c9-9d85-3fd3518592dc.definition: Words used to say hello to someone.
ac93d068-7c3e-55c9-9d85-3fd3518592dc.scene: Photo: Candid rainy street greeting: a young South Asian man in a green waterproof jacket raises his hand to an older Black neighbour in a bright red scarf at a brick doorway; umbrellas and wet reflections, spontaneous smiles.
ac93d068-7c3e-55c9-9d85-3fd3518592dc.alt: A man under an umbrella and a neighbour in a doorway wave hello to each other.

3d64c3c9-ede0-5ffd-b1ef-278f6b70e486.scene: Illustration: Two older friends reunite on a riverside walk and show one another old photographs; one has a shaved head and brown coat, one grey curls and a red scarf; autumn orange leaves, slate river and animated conversation.
3d64c3c9-ede0-5ffd-b1ef-278f6b70e486.alt: Two old friends talk animatedly while sharing old photographs beside a river.

fd6c39c0-f097-5a5b-b947-c93096e635d0.definition: A lesson given by an instructor to a class.
fd6c39c0-f097-5a5b-b947-c93096e635d0.scene: Photo: Wide lecture hall from the back row: Black woman lecturer in a white blouse gestures toward a simple projected geometry figure; diverse adult students taking notes, concrete walls, cool daylight and a yellow backpack.
fd6c39c0-f097-5a5b-b947-c93096e635d0.alt: An instructor explains a projected triangle to students taking notes in a lecture hall.

9ab971f4-9b7b-5551-b274-62ad41d9273f.definition: People who can speak about your work.
9ab971f4-9b7b-5551-b274-62ad41d9273f.scene: Diagram: Two distinct employer/workplace vignettes connected by a phone-call line: hiring manager examines an applicant portfolio while a former workshop supervisor describes the work; copper and navy, simple roles rather than repeated cafe faces.
9ab971f4-9b7b-5551-b274-62ad41d9273f.alt: A hiring manager checks an applicant's records while a workshop supervisor speaks about their work by phone.

2a610b3d-4031-5eee-a0be-d3def2cc0b53.definition: The screening process before entering the departure area.
2a610b3d-4031-5eee-a0be-d3def2cc0b53.scene: Photo: Side view of an airport security conveyor: traveller in a burnt-orange sweater places a black carry-on in a tray while a short-haired officer guides the queue; silver scanner, white architecture, crisp purposeful movement.
2a610b3d-4031-5eee-a0be-d3def2cc0b53.alt: A traveller places a carry-on bag in a tray for an airport security scanner.

c99075bf-94cb-5f51-90d5-f244f66ea942.scene: Diagram: Seven blank calendar columns, the last two highlighted with camping and cycling pictograms and two planning hands; emerald, yellow and off-white, broad clean shapes, no room or written day labels.
c99075bf-94cb-5f51-90d5-f244f66ea942.alt: Hands plan camping and cycling in the final two columns of a seven-day calendar.

d990ce6e-4756-52e0-96e8-9926442963f2.definition: An electronic card used to open your room.
d990ce6e-4756-52e0-96e8-9926442963f2.scene: Photo: Extreme close-up of a dark-skinned hand holding a coral hotel key card to a brushed-steel door lock; green indicator lights, rich burgundy door and dark corridor; no people or repeated lobby.
d990ce6e-4756-52e0-96e8-9926442963f2.alt: A hand holds a key card to an electronic hotel door lock with a green light.

c7796a82-cc8d-56de-a97f-773ea694e337.definition: Skills and experience for a job.
c7796a82-cc8d-56de-a97f-773ea694e337.scene: Illustration: A mature woman engineer in charcoal workwear presents a certificate and photographs of a completed machine to an interviewer; copper tools, teal industrial workshop and confident open gesture, no generic office pair.
c7796a82-cc8d-56de-a97f-773ea694e337.alt: An engineer shows an interviewer her certificate and photographs of machines she worked on.

2534b539-a80f-5001-b9a4-27a5e0679539.definition: A small dish eaten before the main meal.
2534b539-a80f-5001-b9a4-27a5e0679539.scene: Photo: Food photography: small bright tomato-and-olive starter on a white side plate arriving beside a larger still-empty dinner plate; server's cropped hand sets it down, deep green tablecloth, crisp natural side light.
2534b539-a80f-5001-b9a4-27a5e0679539.alt: A server sets down a small tomato-and-olive starter beside an empty main-meal plate.

3265c02c-5751-5465-b94b-e767aa871d8d.scene: Illustration: Two neighbours make light conversation while walking dogs on a sunny residential path; one young East Asian woman in a peach coat, one older bearded man in denim; greenery, cobalt sky and casual moving poses.
3265c02c-5751-5465-b94b-e767aa871d8d.alt: Two neighbours chat casually while walking their dogs along a sunny path.

52c8ed28-544d-5a80-a911-6ddd03953606.scene: Illustration: Evening restaurant terrace: host in a black vest gestures arriving guests toward a neatly prepared table held for them; amber candles, scarlet flowers, dark teal city backdrop; seating preparation and welcome central.
52c8ed28-544d-5a80-a911-6ddd03953606.alt: A restaurant host welcomes arriving guests to a table prepared for them.

edb20c6e-1023-5f10-af4b-0dc059a781b2.definition: A booking for a room at a hotel.
edb20c6e-1023-5f10-af4b-0dc059a781b2.scene: Photo: Small alpine hotel reception in winter: elderly guest in a bright yellow hiking jacket presents a booking document to a brunette receptionist in forest green; snowy window, stone wall, packed red duffel; candid checking action.
edb20c6e-1023-5f10-af4b-0dc059a781b2.alt: An arriving hotel guest presents his room booking to a receptionist at a snowy alpine hotel.

846f3dde-4b90-5eb8-929e-ecd28e8315f3.definition: The process of leaving a hotel.
846f3dde-4b90-5eb8-929e-ecd28e8315f3.scene: Photo: Low-angle hotel departure: guest with long braids in a terracotta jacket returns a white key card to a receptionist with an outstretched hand, rolling black luggage angled toward glass exit; morning sun and strong movement.
846f3dde-4b90-5eb8-929e-ecd28e8315f3.alt: A guest returns her hotel key card while pulling packed luggage toward the exit.

dfe9c593-cf2e-505b-96ca-4afef46422d8.scene: Diagram: Cutaway hotel with three clearly readable facilities: pool, exercise bicycle room and coffee/towel station; no faces, no words; aqua water, orange fitness equipment, dark green rooms, simple isometric architecture.
dfe9c593-cf2e-505b-96ca-4afef46422d8.alt: A hotel cutaway shows a swimming pool, exercise room, coffee maker and fresh towels.

1e9e55f8-d329-5c52-bc30-7ed77a31a167.scene: Photo: Street food documentary scene: curly-haired man in a yellow cycling jacket walks out of a small takeaway shop carrying a lidded meal and red paper bag; brick street, cloudy daylight, mid-step motion.
1e9e55f8-d329-5c52-bc30-7ed77a31a167.alt: A man walks out of a food shop carrying a takeaway meal and a paper bag.

de015c5a-0fad-507d-944e-572f6a10da66.definition: A scheduled phone call to wake you up.
de015c5a-0fad-507d-944e-572f6a10da66.scene: Photo: Dawn hotel bedside scene: older man with greying hair in white sleepwear reaches for a ringing black bedside telephone; orange sunrise across linen and dark wood, sleepy natural gesture, no floating fantasy room.
de015c5a-0fad-507d-944e-572f6a10da66.alt: At sunrise, a sleepy hotel guest reaches for a ringing bedside telephone.

e5817d4f-eaf9-577e-881f-b100fe1e24f8.definition: A summary of your work experience and skills.
e5817d4f-eaf9-577e-881f-b100fe1e24f8.scene: Photo: Top-down work-history document with chronological rows, small skill symbols and a generic portrait placeholder beside a red pen and black laptop; tan hand straightens the page; clean cool-grey desk, no readable private information.
e5817d4f-eaf9-577e-881f-b100fe1e24f8.alt: Hands straighten a work-history document with experience rows and skill symbols beside a laptop.

58529fdd-9425-5aef-a8c7-bc1086be7080.scene: Diagram: A course booklet opens into a compact sequence of topic/book/assignment icons across blank weekly cells; one hand flips a page; lime green and charcoal on white, clean paper objects, no full classroom.
58529fdd-9425-5aef-a8c7-bc1086be7080.alt: A hand turns a course booklet showing a sequence of topics, books and assignments.

0d267f75-f227-5478-962d-b4b944e0e93e.definition: Relaxed and informal in style or conversation.
0d267f75-f227-5478-962d-b4b944e0e93e.scene: Photo: Candid relaxed gathering in a sunny urban park: friends in everyday denim, striped cotton and orange sneakers sit informally on grass, laughing with loose posture; bright green lawn, blue sky, no formal coats or posed cafe composition.
0d267f75-f227-5478-962d-b4b944e0e93e.alt: Friends in casual clothes sit on the grass and laugh together in a sunny park.

b571a540-89bb-533b-be81-9cedf443a64a.definition: The latest time something must be finished.
b571a540-89bb-533b-be81-9cedf443a64a.scene: Diagram: Project task moves through three stages toward a bold final calendar marker beside a clock; the last task becomes checked just before the marker; crimson and slate, explicit final limit without readable text.
b571a540-89bb-533b-be81-9cedf443a64a.alt: A task progresses to completion beside a highlighted calendar deadline and a clock.

f582a137-c77d-58df-942e-884fe336cd64.scene: Photo: Candid evening adult classroom: student in a mustard hoodie hands completed coursework to a silver-haired instructor beside an assignment tray and analog clock; deep blue dusk through windows, urgent reaching movement.
f582a137-c77d-58df-942e-884fe336cd64.alt: A student hands coursework to an instructor beside a submission tray and classroom clock.

ae72824e-1341-5081-84ea-0e0fdbf09c50.definition: Work a teacher asks students to complete.
ae72824e-1341-5081-84ea-0e0fdbf09c50.scene: Illustration: Art class assignment: teacher in a red shirt hands a drawing task sheet to a student in green; a small connected second view shows the student working on that exact task; cream, black and vermilion, clear handoff action.
ae72824e-1341-5081-84ea-0e0fdbf09c50.alt: An art teacher gives a drawing assignment to a student, who then works on it.

bd5eacb6-be32-5e7b-a8d7-d56db1908347.definition: Extra money given to thank someone for service.
bd5eacb6-be32-5e7b-a8d7-d56db1908347.scene: Photo: Close-up cafe counter: a customer leaves two extra coins beside an already-paid receipt while a server's hand collects the empty cup; emerald tiles, brass edge and warm sunlight, no repeated smiling couple.
bd5eacb6-be32-5e7b-a8d7-d56db1908347.alt: A customer leaves coins beside a receipt while a server collects an empty coffee cup.

ee53d6ba-4303-5394-b7f9-79937ce66d09.definition: To ask someone to come to an event or do something with you.
ee53d6ba-4303-5394-b7f9-79937ce66d09.scene: Illustration: Community garden host in yellow overalls extends a simple event card to a newcomer in a turquoise coat and gestures toward people planting together; lively green leaves and coral flowers, welcoming movement.
ee53d6ba-4303-5394-b7f9-79937ce66d09.alt: A community garden host offers an event card and welcomes a newcomer to the gardening group.

0c030a86-51fc-5d13-9246-09950c45a43c.definition: To take part in an activity with other people.
0c030a86-51fc-5d13-9246-09950c45a43c.scene: Illustration: A newcomer in an orange T-shirt pulls a chair into a mixed-age board-game group on a rooftop terrace; others slide the board toward them; rich navy evening sky, warm red lanterns, expansive diagonal action.
0c030a86-51fc-5d13-9246-09950c45a43c.alt: A newcomer pulls a chair up to a group playing a board game on a rooftop terrace.

b2d5132c-b969-587f-975d-4009c454968f.definition: Not busy and able to do something at a particular time.
b2d5132c-b969-587f-975d-4009c454968f.scene: Diagram: Busy calendar cells carry work/activity icons while one empty cell is highlighted beside a coffee invitation; a finger selects the free cell; tangerine, turquoise and white, no rendered room or generic faces.
b2d5132c-b969-587f-975d-4009c454968f.alt: A finger selects an empty calendar slot for coffee among other busy days.

d602623a-1bf7-5656-b867-484d2be3f5a9.definition: To give an idea for someone to consider.
d602623a-1bf7-5656-b867-484d2be3f5a9.scene: Illustration: Two friends beside a lake consider an outing: a woman with short black hair in a red fleece points to a picnic area and the other listens; turquoise water, golden grass, visible proposing gesture, no floating cafe room.
d602623a-1bf7-5656-b867-484d2be3f5a9.alt: A woman suggests a lakeside picnic spot to a friend.

40ed986a-7261-54eb-a3c8-4213c3bdc4fd.definition: To plan and organize something that will happen.
40ed986a-7261-54eb-a3c8-4213c3bdc4fd.scene: Illustration: Community event preparation in a hall: older organizer in a green jumpsuit moves chairs while another marks a blank schedule and signals a helper; orange chairs, pale pink wall and charcoal floor, practical busy action.
40ed986a-7261-54eb-a3c8-4213c3bdc4fd.alt: Organizers arrange chairs and coordinate an event schedule in a hall.

6348aad5-937a-57d0-aebc-15887a771938.definition: To state that a planned time or arrangement is correct or definite.
6348aad5-937a-57d0-aebc-15887a771938.scene: Diagram: Two matching appointment slots face one another and resolve into one large check mark; small nodding profile icons acknowledge agreement; coral and dark green on clean white, no cafe or copied clothing.
6348aad5-937a-57d0-aebc-15887a771938.alt: Two people agree on matching appointment times, shown by one large check mark.

0cdfa962-ee1c-570d-8533-999088905805.definition: To change the time or date of a planned event.
0cdfa962-ee1c-570d-8533-999088905805.scene: Diagram: A small orange event card visibly moves from an earlier calendar cell to a later green cell along a bold curved arrow; magenta accent and white background, simple hand and no decorative room.
0cdfa962-ee1c-570d-8533-999088905805.alt: An event card moves from an earlier calendar slot to a later one.

f98bfb7b-c140-55a6-b76c-774ee096d1ca.definition: To stop a planned event or arrangement from going ahead.
f98bfb7b-c140-55a6-b76c-774ee096d1ca.scene: Diagram: A picnic-plan pictogram in a blank calendar cell is clearly crossed out by a red cancellation stroke, while an unobtrusive hand removes the event card; white, crimson and charcoal, no reschedule arrow.
f98bfb7b-c140-55a6-b76c-774ee096d1ca.alt: A hand removes a picnic event card marked with a large cancellation cross.

b535cf81-3777-5553-959d-1ccf9d22a209.definition: At the planned or expected time; not late.
b535cf81-3777-5553-959d-1ccf9d22a209.scene: Illustration: Young man in a red running jacket strides through a community-class doorway just as the wall clock matches his watch; teacher opens the door, teal wall and yellow morning light, timely arrival obvious.
b535cf81-3777-5553-959d-1ccf9d22a209.alt: A learner arrives for class on time and checks his watch as the teacher welcomes him.

52b8ebc0-ba65-579d-8749-6ff51b9ce6b5.definition: Used to say that you like an idea or plan.
52b8ebc0-ba65-579d-8749-6ff51b9ce6b5.scene: Illustration: A woman in a black-and-white striped shirt proposes a beach outing on a simple map, and a friend with grey hair in orange gives an enthusiastic thumbs-up; sunny coastal colors, no cafe cups or lavender outfits.
52b8ebc0-ba65-579d-8749-6ff51b9ce6b5.alt: A friend gives a thumbs-up to a suggested beach outing.

c5454676-5349-52d2-ad14-814d516fed56.definition: To meet another person, usually to spend time together.
c5454676-5349-52d2-ad14-814d516fed56.scene: Photo: Wide candid friends meeting outside a busy outdoor market: woman with a buzz cut in a red coat and a Black man in an olive shirt approach with open arms; striped stalls, warm noon light and real street movement.
c5454676-5349-52d2-ad14-814d516fed56.alt: Two friends meet at an outdoor market and approach each other with open arms.

ddde743f-15ab-5d13-bea6-9835a56c991d.definition: To continue communicating with someone over time.
ddde743f-15ab-5d13-bea6-9835a56c991d.scene: Diagram: Three small dated-by-position panels show two friends exchanging messages at different times and locations; repeating send/receive arrows connect the panels; violet, lime and white, continuity over time central, no full sofa scenes.
ddde743f-15ab-5d13-bea6-9835a56c991d.alt: Friends exchange messages at different times and places to keep in touch.

7dee60f4-25c4-5d55-9111-dc5174dcd5b5.definition: A measurement or category showing how big something is, especially clothes.
7dee60f4-25c4-5d55-9111-dc5174dcd5b5.scene: Photo: Top-down three identical cotton shirts in clearly different sizes laid out from small to large with a measuring tape; shirts are red on a pale blue table; cropped hands compare edges, no faces or boutique-room template.
7dee60f4-25c4-5d55-9111-dc5174dcd5b5.alt: Hands compare three red shirts of different sizes beside a measuring tape.

481f699b-4788-5620-b8a5-51347d90e6e5.definition: To put on clothes or shoes to see whether they suit you or fit.
481f699b-4788-5620-b8a5-51347d90e6e5.scene: Photo: Candid shoe-shop scene: older East Asian woman in a green jacket tries on a bright red trainer, bending to test the heel and toes; her original shoe nearby, raw wood bench and white daylight, no mirror jacket pose.
481f699b-4788-5620-b8a5-51347d90e6e5.alt: A woman tries on a red trainer and checks the heel in a shoe shop.

6c80ff44-eb45-5332-b48d-228872ead757.definition: To be the right size and shape for someone.
6c80ff44-eb45-5332-b48d-228872ead757.scene: Photo: Tailor close-up of a charcoal jacket fitting a broad-shouldered Black man correctly at wrists and shoulders; woman tailor in a mustard apron checks the cuff; deep crimson workshop curtain, clear garment-fit details.
6c80ff44-eb45-5332-b48d-228872ead757.alt: A tailor checks that a man's jacket fits correctly at the cuff and shoulders.

74a55fe5-7736-58f0-98b8-23eef998067d.definition: A paper or electronic record showing that you have paid.
74a55fe5-7736-58f0-98b8-23eef998067d.scene: Photo: Extreme close-up of a cash register printing a receipt as a hand takes it beside a paid blue shopping bag; warm red checkout surface, white paper and dark scanner; no repeated person-to-person portrait.
74a55fe5-7736-58f0-98b8-23eef998067d.alt: A customer takes a printed receipt from a checkout register beside a shopping bag.

538cc7f5-983c-59cc-8664-173cefca65ad.definition: Money returned to someone who has paid for something.
538cc7f5-983c-59cc-8664-173cefca65ad.scene: Diagram: Return flow with boxed headphones moving from customer to shop and a separate coin/payment arrow flowing back; orange, navy and white, two opposing directions clearly distinct from exchanging goods.
538cc7f5-983c-59cc-8664-173cefca65ad.alt: A customer returns headphones to a shop and receives money back.

c916143f-197b-5cd7-a4c9-7b21178f04aa.definition: To return something you bought and receive another item instead.
c916143f-197b-5cd7-a4c9-7b21178f04aa.scene: Illustration: Two garments visibly swap across a clothing-store counter: shopper with short silver hair in black hands over a striped shirt and receives a red shirt from a clerk in green; angular composition and distinct two-way action.
c916143f-197b-5cd7-a4c9-7b21178f04aa.alt: A shopper exchanges a striped shirt for a red shirt at a clothing-store counter.

e507b507-5432-51a0-bcc3-be12294143db.definition: Money paid regularly to use a home owned by someone else.
e507b507-5432-51a0-bcc3-be12294143db.scene: Diagram: Apartment icon above a repeating monthly sequence of rent coin transfers from tenant to owner; green and orange on off-white, show recurrence and housing clearly without readable numbers.
e507b507-5432-51a0-bcc3-be12294143db.alt: A tenant makes repeated rent payments to a property owner for an apartment.

75be2229-a161-5e08-856f-143098221439.definition: A person or company that rents out a home or other property.
75be2229-a161-5e08-856f-143098221439.scene: Photo: Candid older female property owner in an olive coat hands apartment keys to a young tenant in a scarlet shirt at a sunlit concrete doorway; rental document tucked under arm, handover close and natural.
75be2229-a161-5e08-856f-143098221439.alt: A property owner hands apartment keys to a tenant at the doorway.

3c382279-cf27-5d6b-ba75-a0389f1d5680.definition: Work done to fix something that is broken or damaged.
3c382279-cf27-5d6b-ba75-a0389f1d5680.scene: Photo: Female plumber with short hair in red work overalls tightens a leaking kitchen tap with a wrench; wet silver sink and lime-green tile, close low-angle view with active hands, no smiling posed male worker.
3c382279-cf27-5d6b-ba75-a0389f1d5680.alt: A plumber tightens a leaking kitchen tap with a wrench.

bf1bee5c-b8f0-5ebc-9252-53c4ac9ef7de.definition: A place where a bus stops so passengers can get on or off.
bf1bee5c-b8f0-5ebc-9252-53c4ac9ef7de.scene: Photo: Rainy city bus stop at night: varied passengers shelter beneath a yellow-lit canopy while a red bus pulls up; wet pavement reflections, waiting line and stop sign visible, wide candid environmental frame.
bf1bee5c-b8f0-5ebc-9252-53c4ac9ef7de.alt: Passengers wait under a lit bus shelter as a red bus arrives on a rainy night.

6d08080d-4855-5652-ae35-cf0c2bcb9222.definition: A list of the times when transport services arrive or leave.
6d08080d-4855-5652-ae35-cf0c2bcb9222.scene: Diagram: Orderly transit timetable rows of small train pictograms and distinct clock faces, a hand traces one row; mint, charcoal and coral, no decorative station architecture or readable times.
6d08080d-4855-5652-ae35-cf0c2bcb9222.alt: A traveller points to one row of train departure times shown with clock faces.

9aa8876d-25c6-54d1-9b65-0816e604e7a5.definition: The area beside a railway track where people wait for and enter a train.
9aa8876d-25c6-54d1-9b65-0816e604e7a5.scene: Photo: Wide railway platform at dawn: travellers walk toward open doors of a green train behind a yellow safety line; pink sky and strong perspective along rails, no posed central woman.
9aa8876d-25c6-54d1-9b65-0816e604e7a5.alt: Travellers walk along a railway platform and board a green train at dawn.

faf13c57-a106-5406-a2bc-e743eb00ec4e.definition: A travel ticket for a journey in one direction only.
faf13c57-a106-5406-a2bc-e743eb00ec4e.scene: Diagram: One generic ticket beside a single bold arrow from a small origin-station icon to a destination station; orange and navy on white, no return arrow or decorative traveller portrait.
faf13c57-a106-5406-a2bc-e743eb00ec4e.alt: One train ticket above a one-way arrow between two stations.

35b47079-26eb-5441-bf1d-05060d125a7e.definition: A travel ticket for a journey to a place and back again.
35b47079-26eb-5441-bf1d-05060d125a7e.scene: Diagram: One generic return ticket beside two clearly separated arrows: outward from one station to another and back to the first; emerald and red on pale grey, no people or full station.
35b47079-26eb-5441-bf1d-05060d125a7e.alt: A return train ticket beside arrows for an outward journey and a journey back.

91888c86-1fc6-5633-a6dd-a46017f8fdf7.definition: To leave one bus or train and continue your journey on another.
91888c86-1fc6-5633-a6dd-a46017f8fdf7.scene: Illustration: Dynamic transfer in a transport hub: a traveller in yellow gets off an orange bus and strides toward a dark green bus; clear connecting path, cropped urban architecture and overcast sky, no leisurely cafe scene.
91888c86-1fc6-5633-a6dd-a46017f8fdf7.alt: A traveller leaves an orange bus and walks toward a green bus to continue her journey.

0b593408-6679-5fb8-a21c-b73a525c76e5.definition: An object or group of objects wrapped for sending or delivery.
0b593408-6679-5fb8-a21c-b73a525c76e5.scene: Photo: Product photograph of a sealed corrugated parcel with twine and a plain address label on a red postal counter; dark-skinned hands finish securing the tape; neutral industrial backdrop, no leafy cottage.
0b593408-6679-5fb8-a21c-b73a525c76e5.alt: Hands tape a cardboard parcel with twine and a plain label on a postal counter.

3bb8e710-2cfb-5f6f-a281-c0a167d46fb2.definition: The details of where someone lives or where a building is.
3bb8e710-2cfb-5f6f-a281-c0a167d46fb2.scene: Diagram: A plain parcel label with address lines connects via a location pin to exactly one doorway on a simple street strip; coral, slate and pale yellow, one clearly matched destination, no realistic courier portrait.
3bb8e710-2cfb-5f6f-a281-c0a167d46fb2.alt: A parcel address label connects to a marked house on a street.

4609031d-af20-550a-906e-3fd3cde7588e.definition: The act of bringing goods or a parcel to a person or place.
4609031d-af20-550a-906e-3fd3cde7588e.scene: Photo: Courier with a shaved head in a green jacket hands a medium parcel to an older woman in a bright red sweater at a modern apartment door; compact trolley enters frame, cloudy daylight, decisive exchange.
4609031d-af20-550a-906e-3fd3cde7588e.alt: A courier hands a parcel to an older woman at her apartment door.

b20c1447-0e63-5712-9ae7-dd4aca9aeb85.definition: Money in the form of coins or notes.
b20c1447-0e63-5712-9ae7-dd4aca9aeb85.scene: Photo: Macro still-life of paper banknotes and several coins spilling gently from an open brown wallet onto a dark green market counter; one cropped hand, no bank card, readable lettering blurred or abstract.
b20c1447-0e63-5712-9ae7-dd4aca9aeb85.alt: Banknotes and coins spill from an open wallet onto a market counter.

d78438f3-30bd-58bf-9b96-1489c4f57d3b.definition: A card linked to a bank account or credit account, used to pay or obtain money.
d78438f3-30bd-58bf-9b96-1489c4f57d3b.scene: Photo: Close-up of a dark-skinned hand tapping a plain orange chip bank card on a black terminal at a street cafe; stainless tabletop, white cup and crisp daylight; no generated account numbers or bank logo.
d78438f3-30bd-58bf-9b96-1489c4f57d3b.alt: A hand taps a plain orange bank card on a contactless payment terminal.

c6a6c8f7-1ce0-59df-b963-e07066796992.definition: The act of paying money, or an amount of money paid.
c6a6c8f7-1ce0-59df-b963-e07066796992.scene: Illustration: Outdoor market payment: cyclist in a red helmet hands cash to an older fruit seller in a green apron as the seller passes a bag of oranges; vivid orange produce, blue awning and lively action.
c6a6c8f7-1ce0-59df-b963-e07066796992.alt: A cyclist gives cash to a fruit seller while receiving a bag of oranges.

b548ade3-8682-521e-bf26-848526519854.definition: A document with spaces for information that you need to provide.
b548ade3-8682-521e-bf26-848526519854.scene: Photo: Overhead document photograph: left-handed person fills empty boxes on a white application form with a red pen; green clipboard on a black desk, cropped brown hand and sleeve, no readable personal details.
b548ade3-8682-521e-bf26-848526519854.alt: A hand holds a red pen over the boxes of a form on a green clipboard.

c7bbc8ae-3f64-58e9-acf0-3069e317c471.definition: Your name written in your usual way to sign a document.
c7bbc8ae-3f64-58e9-acf0-3069e317c471.scene: Photo: Macro photograph of an older wrinkled hand making a flowing signature on the bottom line of a document with a black pen; cream paper, red desktop edge and dramatic natural side light.
c7bbc8ae-3f64-58e9-acf0-3069e317c471.alt: An older hand writes a flowing signature on the bottom line of a document.

64360906-46e2-588e-96d7-c78213875c9b.definition: A line of people waiting for something.
64360906-46e2-588e-96d7-c78213875c9b.scene: Photo: Wide candid queue outside a small bakery: people of different ages in red, yellow, navy and olive coats wait in one clear line; pale brick wall and morning sun, first person entering doorway, no repeated cafe counter.
64360906-46e2-588e-96d7-c78213875c9b.alt: People wait in a single queue outside a bakery as the first customer enters.

c76cb86d-be5a-5375-8d88-72bda7b98e7d.definition: An arrangement to meet someone at a particular time, often for a service.
c76cb86d-be5a-5375-8d88-72bda7b98e7d.scene: Diagram: Service appointment concept: a hand selects one calendar slot, connected to a clinician pictogram and a matching clock; peach, dark teal and white, simple intentional arrangement without a full clinic room.
c76cb86d-be5a-5375-8d88-72bda7b98e7d.alt: A selected calendar slot connects to a clinician and a clock for an appointment.

096a46ea-93b8-59c2-9423-bc07f3332297.definition: A physical or mental change that may be a sign of an illness or health problem.
096a46ea-93b8-59c2-9423-bc07f3332297.scene: Photo: Candid clinic consultation: older South Asian man in a green sweater touches his sore throat while speaking to a Black woman clinician in a white coat; cool white examination room and amber daylight, clear concerned gesture.
096a46ea-93b8-59c2-9423-bc07f3332297.alt: A patient touches his sore throat while describing it to a clinician.

c3a26504-d404-5151-bbac-5e22511aae5f.definition: A shop or service where people can get medicines.
c3a26504-d404-5151-bbac-5e22511aae5f.scene: Photo: Street-level pharmacy interior: male pharmacist with short silver hair reaches for a plain medicine box while a woman in a red coat waits; bright green shelving, cool white counters, no brand labels or repeated blue-purple palette.
c3a26504-d404-5151-bbac-5e22511aae5f.alt: A pharmacist reaches for a medicine box while a customer waits at the counter.

5966f508-b502-5669-a7d6-c619ce92639f.definition: The connection received by a mobile phone that allows it to communicate.
5966f508-b502-5669-a7d6-c619ce92639f.scene: Diagram: A phone moves from a grey one-bar connection area to an open green strong-bar area; a clear arrow and small antenna line explain improved mobile connection; lime, black and white, no full hiker portrait.
5966f508-b502-5669-a7d6-c619ce92639f.alt: A phone moves from weak signal to strong signal near a mobile antenna.

2fd7a730-c9e9-5a7b-b094-dea868bc7cd3.definition: A system for recording spoken messages when a phone call is not answered, or a message on that system.
2fd7a730-c9e9-5a7b-b094-dea868bc7cd3.scene: Diagram: An unanswered incoming-call symbol leads to a captured voice waveform and play control on a phone; warm orange and slate on cream, one simple flow with no smiling person or sofa background.
2fd7a730-c9e9-5a7b-b094-dea868bc7cd3.alt: An incoming call leads to a recorded voice message that can be played on a phone.

e1b649b8-b6d8-5caf-8671-5b9e57ebd71c.definition: To phone someone after they have phoned you.
e1b649b8-b6d8-5caf-8671-5b9e57ebd71c.scene: Diagram: Two connected phone states: a missed incoming call followed by an outgoing call toward the same contact silhouette; red then green arrows, clean white background, no repeated room or full faces.
e1b649b8-b6d8-5caf-8671-5b9e57ebd71c.alt: A missed incoming call is followed by an outgoing call to the same contact.

ee851d91-6476-5942-9454-8f1b2db92682.definition: A file sent with an email or other electronic message.
ee851d91-6476-5942-9454-8f1b2db92682.scene: Diagram: A small document/photo tile travels along one clear arrow into an envelope-message with a paperclip; cobalt, sunflower and white, object-only layout, no laptop/room/person template.
ee851d91-6476-5942-9454-8f1b2db92682.alt: A photo document is added to an email envelope marked with a paperclip.

ae343b98-d972-5565-8bac-87f04fe96d06.definition: A clickable address or item that opens an online page or resource.
ae343b98-d972-5565-8bac-87f04fe96d06.scene: Diagram: A fingertip selects an underlined item on one simple page, and a clear arrow opens a different page beside it; coral and deep navy on white, no readable letters or decorative tablet scene.
ae343b98-d972-5565-8bac-87f04fe96d06.alt: A fingertip selects an underlined link to open another web page.

2d1adc4c-058b-5d12-ae17-86afc4195588.definition: To answer a message or question.
2d1adc4c-058b-5d12-ae17-86afc4195588.scene: Diagram: An incoming message bubble travels to a recipient and a differently colored response travels back to the original sender; turquoise and orange arrows on a pale grey background, two simple phone silhouettes only.
2d1adc4c-058b-5d12-ae17-86afc4195588.alt: A message travels to another phone and a response travels back to the sender.

f97ad45b-01ee-51f9-b77a-ddab1881b374.definition: A scheduled period of time when someone works.
f97ad45b-01ee-51f9-b77a-ddab1881b374.scene: Illustration: Dusk hospital staff handover: outgoing older nurse in pale green takes off a badge while younger nurse in rust-colored scrubs steps into the ward; clock marks the work-period transition, navy corridor and warm amber light.
f97ad45b-01ee-51f9-b77a-ddab1881b374.alt: One nurse finishes work as another arrives for the next hospital shift.

ea64a58a-2521-50fa-8af9-a5cf9e013763.definition: A short time when you stop working to rest.
ea64a58a-2521-50fa-8af9-a5cf9e013763.scene: Photo: Candid factory break outdoors: worker with cropped grey hair in orange overalls sits on a courtyard bench drinking water away from machinery; blue sky, green tree shade and relaxed posture, no office window tea pose.
ea64a58a-2521-50fa-8af9-a5cf9e013763.alt: A factory worker rests on a bench and drinks water during a break.

8ecac8d4-b7c0-51bb-95be-14a73d8637e3.scene: Photo: Two bakery colleagues, one dark-skinned man in a white apron and one woman with braided hair in a red apron, knead dough side by side at a flour-dusted counter; warm oven glow, active hands and shared work.
8ecac8d4-b7c0-51bb-95be-14a73d8637e3.alt: Two bakery colleagues knead dough side by side at a flour-covered counter.

e62a2ba4-c6b7-5186-98f6-20d69f4dc196.definition: New information about the current state or progress of something.
e62a2ba4-c6b7-5186-98f6-20d69f4dc196.scene: Diagram: Three project-status cards advance from incomplete grey tasks to newly checked green tasks as a pointer highlights the newest changes; forest green, coral and white, compact progress information without office portrait.
e62a2ba4-c6b7-5186-98f6-20d69f4dc196.alt: Project status cards show newly completed tasks as a pointer highlights the latest progress.

c1e69c4e-2915-5c99-96ab-d946e67653fd.definition: A talk that explains a topic to an audience, often using pictures or slides.
c1e69c4e-2915-5c99-96ab-d946e67653fd.scene: Illustration: Public science presentation in an outdoor amphitheatre: speaker with short silver hair in a bright red jacket gestures to a simple star-and-planet display; varied seated audience, navy twilight and yellow stage light, energetic wide composition.
c1e69c4e-2915-5c99-96ab-d946e67653fd.alt: A speaker presents a star-and-planet display to an outdoor audience at twilight.
